capability_groups.name: Remote authentication backend trust and saved-session binding
capability_groups.finding: Validates MCP origin and the advertised auth backend before restoring saved credentials, binds persisted sessions to the complete MCP/auth endpoint pair, rejects authentication redirects, and retains old credentials until replacement authorization succeeds.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Security patch is v0.3.3. Custom third-party MCP domains are intentionally rejected by this upstream remote launcher.

capability_groups.name: POSIX, PowerShell and CMD command inspection
capability_groups.finding: Shell-aware readers inspect nested shell text, wrappers and known targets; outcomes are allowed, blocked, unseen and failed. Blocking or inspection failure refuses execution; unseen dynamic targets and script contents can still execute with a notice.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: This is a best-effort blocklist, not isolation, least privilege, or a guarantee that arbitrary shell commands are safe.

capability_groups.name: Managed process-tree termination
capability_groups.finding: force_terminate and kill_process on a managed start_process PID terminate the managed command tree. Windows uses taskkill /T /F; POSIX walks parent-child snapshots with TERM then KILL. Unmanaged PIDs use single-PID termination.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: POSIX descendants already reparented before enumeration may be unfindable. node:local negative IDs are stopped with force_terminate.

capability_groups.name: Remote tool-call timeout alignment
capability_groups.finding: The local MCP SDK request timeout is 30 minutes plus 30 seconds, aligned to the documented server sweep rather than the SDK default. A tool can outlive the initial synchronous response.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Timeout does not prove side effects were canceled; durable job cancellation is a separate requirement.

capability_groups.name: Filesystem boundary and symlink checks
capability_groups.finding: Allowed-directory resolution and validation handle links and nonexistent targets; v0.3.0 release includes dangling-link write validation and allowed symlink traversal corrections.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PR #886 still proposes POSIX case-sensitive allowed-directory comparison. Filesystem guards do not sandbox arbitrary terminal commands.

capability_groups.name: Prevent accidental overwrite when mode omitted
capability_groups.finding: The write handler refuses an omitted write mode on an existing nonempty target; explicit rewrite and append modes remain available.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PR #984 removes a misleading schema default that conflicts with the existing runtime guard.

capability_groups.name: MCP side-effect annotations
capability_groups.finding: All 25 advertised tools carry read-only, destructive and open-world hints. These describe behavior and are not enforcement by themselves.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.

capability_groups.name: OAuth device pairing and hosted multi-device portal
capability_groups.finding: The public documentation describes browser device-code approval, paired device listing/revocation, multiple computers, and client OAuth with PKCE. The local pairing implementation is public; hosted service backend is closed source.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Documentation and client source were inspected; no new device was paired and no hosted authorization boundary was penetration tested.

capability_groups.name: Public remote-device launchers
capability_groups.finding: v0.3.2 release includes public remote launchers and a subsequent launcher change to install Node 24.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Launchers reuse Node 22.12+, ask before installing Node 24, verify runtime SHA-256 and execute the device as the initiating user. Downloads/install actions were not executed by this audit.

capability_groups.name: Readiness distinct from transport presence
capability_groups.finding: Online admission combines actual local executor readiness with transport reachability; local-child loss marks device unreachable and triggers an active restart loop. Readiness requires a successful request, not only a handshake. Presence is dashboard best effort.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.

capability_groups.name: Reconnect, sleep recovery and token refresh
capability_groups.finding: Uses jittered reconnect/watchdog backoff, bounded readiness writes, local-executor restart and persisted rotated tokens. Pending calls are recovered in bounded batches.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PR #829 proposes further refresh-failure retry and AC-only sleep handling; no full outage/reboot matrix was executed here.

capability_groups.name: MQTT certificate enrollment and observation
capability_groups.finding: Uses per-device certificate/key enrollment, TLS certificate validation, exact topics and identity validation, clean sessions, QoS1 subscription acknowledgement, reconnect/subscription readiness, bounded result acknowledgement and telemetry.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Current onMqttDoorbell has no dispatch body: incoming MQTT is shadow observation, not tool execution. The optional incoming execution flag cannot enable execution. Open PR #732 is a proposal, not shipped execution.

capability_groups.name: Correlation IDs, deduplication and interrupted delivery
capability_groups.finding: Call IDs identify notifications/results; an in-memory seen-ID guard prevents duplicate execution within the process and conditional DB claims/recovery coordinate delivery.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: The DB claim path can execute on transient DB errors and local dedup is bounded/non-durable. Do not claim durable exactly-once execution across process crashes or partitions.

capability_groups.name: Device revocation and credential cleanup
capability_groups.finding: Logout requests backend revocation and only removes saved session/MQTT identity after confirmed success; failures preserve credentials for retry. Backend and saved-session identity binding are checked.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Server must confirm MQTT revocation. This audit did not revoke the working fallback device.

capability_groups.name: Redacted support ZIP and remote diagnostics
capability_groups.finding: remote --report builds local text/JSON/log ZIP diagnostics with token, path, hostname and identifier filtering; code supports --no-upload.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Diagnostic report creation uploads by default unless --no-upload is supplied. General tool-call logging still includes arguments; a redacted support bundle is not evidence that every log is safe.

capability_groups.name: Windows environment propagation
capability_groups.finding: Restores ProgramData when omitted and passes string-valued device environment variables to the local MCP child.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PR #958 proposes WINDIR restoration. Preserve working per-process environment rather than assuming all filtered variables are repaired.

capability_groups.name: Node 22/24 runtime and Windows libuv pool
capability_groups.finding: Package engines require Node >=22.12.0. Windows Node 22 needs a pre-start environment/relaunch to establish the enlarged pool; Node 24/libuv >=1.52 can read the process environment. Lifecycle coupling makes the child terminate with its launcher.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Some README/plugin instructions still say Node 18. Package engines and tested runtime should govern; open PR #1047 corrects those docs.

capability_groups.name: Output pagination and bounded process waits
capability_groups.finding: Terminal tools support streaming sessions, bounded initial waits and paged output; process/state detection and prompt handling are present.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PRs #948 and #903 propose post-resolve overhead and chunk-boundary UTF-8 fixes; #977 proposes bounded/sortable list_processes.

capability_groups.name: File and Office search completion
capability_groups.finding: Streaming search supports pagination and active-search lifecycle; v0.3.0 release fixes completion, global max-results, limits, ripgrep invocation and Office patterns.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.

capability_groups.name: PDF reading, generation, editing and Docker
capability_groups.finding: PDF read/write, markdown rendering, manipulation and extraction handlers are present; v0.3.2 corrects Docker PDF creation and install refresh.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Rendering requires an available Chrome runtime. Open PR #929 proposes removing eager startup browser acquisition.

capability_groups.name: Excel reading, searching and editing
capability_groups.finding: ExcelJS-backed workbook read/write and Office search exist, including ranges and sparse sheets.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PRs #1051, #979 and #963 respectively address zero-length reads, merged-cell aliases, and quoted sheet names containing exclamation marks.

capability_groups.name: Word/DOCX read and edit
capability_groups.finding: DOCX handler supports document content processing and editing.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open PR #975 proposes preserving XML text/field whitespace during edits; do not equate basic DOCX support with full-fidelity document editing.

capability_groups.name: Markdown preview, editor and conflict handling
capability_groups.finding: File preview has Markdown parsing, rich editing, document outline, disk-change conflict dialog and save conflict handling.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: UI availability depends on the MCP host and metadata/feature gating. Open proposals cover safer link schemes and default widget visibility.

capability_groups.name: Directory browsing, fuzzy edits and images
capability_groups.finding: Directory listing/navigation, edit_block with fuzzy matching, image handling and file-preview UI exist.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.

capability_groups.name: Structured results and MCP schemas
capability_groups.finding: Tools expose input schemas and annotations; selected process/search facts are returned internally while caller-visible text remains compatible.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Do not claim complete outputSchema coverage. Open PRs #923, #988 and #787 propose output and schema portability improvements.

capability_groups.name: MCPB and MCP Registry packaging
capability_groups.finding: Root MCPB manifest, build-mcpb script, registry server.json, package version sync and release workflows exist.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: A manifest in source proves packaging intent; actual hosted client installation and registry listing still require independent verification.

capability_groups.name: Claude, Cursor, VS Code and Gemini integrations
capability_groups.finding: Public plugin/extension manifests and setup docs exist for these clients; the hosted repo separately publishes remote MCP manifests and OAuth setup.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Package versions differ: local MCP npm is 0.3.3, local plugin/extension metadata is 1.5.0, hosted repository main identifies release 1.1.25 while latest GitHub release object is 1.0.80.

capability_groups.name: Native skills and prompt packages
capability_groups.finding: Ships overview, terminal, computer health, AI tools setup, knowledge base and Obsidian skill packages plus onboarding prompt data.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: These are reusable guidance packages, not autonomous intelligence, source-grounded persistent memory, or an implemented agent fleet.

capability_groups.name: Cross-platform tests, coverage and frozen review
capability_groups.finding: Node test runner, platform-aware CI, coverage/reporting, installer tests and frozen-review machinery exist; v0.3.2 promotes these changes.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: No upstream test suite was executed during this read-only source audit, and test existence is not current green CI evidence.

capability_groups.name: Release provenance and alpha promotion
capability_groups.finding: v0.3.3 npm metadata includes SHA-512 integrity, signatures and SLSA provenance attestation. Release tooling supports alpha publication, stable promotion, rehearsal and opt-in skipping of completed tests.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: This audit recorded published integrity/provenance but did not independently cryptographically verify attestations or reproduce the package bit for bit.

capability_groups.name: Arbitrary custom Cloudflare endpoint routing
capability_groups.finding: Upstream 0.3.3 remote launcher restricts MCP_SERVER_URL to Desktop Commander DNS names or explicit local hosts and rejects paths. It is not a generic custom-domain MCP client/enrollment agent.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: MTerm needs its own standards-compatible transport/enrollment or reviewed owner trust configuration, separate credential storage, SSRF controls and per-profile endpoint binding. Removing the checks is not a parity implementation.

capability_groups.name: Independent DEV/staging credential profiles
capability_groups.finding: DC_ENV staging/development still share the same local device session directory. Endpoint binding blocks silent credential reuse; changing endpoints requires reauthorization.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Isolation is explicitly unfinished upstream; MTerm must separately implement profile-scoped session/secret storage.

capability_groups.name: Per-device least privilege and read-only execution
capability_groups.finding: Hosted docs establish paired ownership and device selection, but do not prove the full requested per-device tool/directory permissions, read-only execution, signed identities, or cross-profile authorization matrix.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open proposals #665, #399 and #224 should not be recorded as shipped access-control enforcement.

capability_groups.name: Durable orchestration, leases and cancellation
capability_groups.finding: Remote calls and managed terminal sessions provide execution plumbing; source inspected does not supply the requested durable multi-agent ownership leases, budgeted scheduling, isolated worktrees or formal acceptance register.
capability_groups.mterm_note: Root audit must map this to each deployed MTerm product layer; upstream source presence alone proves no MTerm deployment.
capability_groups.caveat: Open Safe Executor proposal #356 is not released proof; MTerm engineering jobs must be evaluated independently.
